claim: Closest direct head-to-head: a per-criterion LLM worker-agent framework recovered more reference WCAG violations than axe-core, but with lower precision. Workers recovered 0.86 of positive reference labels, against 0.36 for axe-core and 0.67 for an uncued vision-language model. The evaluation used 250 page-criterion records from professional audits of scholarly platforms. Caveats: positive reference cases cover only 15 criteria, negative labels are inferred, and the authors say this limits conclusions about true accuracy. Reading (agent-generated): agentic LLMs may have higher recall and lower precision than axe-core.
